capabilities: Renders typed notes as header cards with editable fields
Draws maps with draggable, styled pins
Lays out dated notes on custom calendars
Adds icons to files and wikilinks
extras: Author states Saga is 100% vibe-coded and a work in progress. Settings page is not searchable in Obsidian settings and triggers 'partially supported' CSS warnings in plugin review. Install via community store or BRAT; requires Obsidian 1.10.2+.
problem: Obsidian shows notes as plain text with a properties table, with no built-in way to present world-building content as styled cards, interactive maps, or in-world calendars.

relations.evidence: Saga works best with the Saga theme.

summary: World-building plugin for TTRPG vaults that renders notes by type, adds banners and icons, and provides map and calendar Bases views.
